title: BrickFlow: Connectivity-Guided Brick Reconstruction
abstract: Given a set of LEGO parts and an image of an assembled object, our task is to infer the pose of each part to assemble the object. In contrast with traditional 3D reconstruction, doing so requires satisfying discrete physical constraints, which provide structure but render the problem combinatorial and highly sensitive to small pose errors. To learn a prior over how parts fit together, we train a set-conditioned SE(3) flow model on procedurally generated assemblies. We then finetune this model to inject image conditioning, using 1% as much data. However, while the learned flow captures global structure, it does not enforce connectivity. To address this, we introduce an analytic connectivity-field guidance to pull predictions toward connected assemblies at test time. Through this, we demonstrate improved build quality with model size, pretraining, and guidance. We make our models and data available for research purposes at https://kulits.github.io/BrickFlow/
tldr: BrickFlow通过集合条件SE(3)流模型与连通性场引导，从图像和零件集重建可组装的LEGO结构。
motivation: 给定LEGO零件集与组装物体图像，需推断每个零件的位姿并完成组装。该任务需满足离散物理约束，问题具有组合性且对微小位姿误差高度敏感，传统3D重建难以直接适用。
method: 在程序生成的装配体上训练set-conditioned SE(3) flow model，学习零件如何拼合的先验；再用仅1%的数据微调以注入图像条件；测试时引入解析的connectivity-field guidance，将预测拉向连通的装配体。
result: 实验表明，构建质量随模型规模、预训练和连通性引导的使用而提升；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 该方法将学习到的SE(3)流先验与解析连通性引导结合，改善了基于图像的LEGO装配重建质量，并公开模型与数据以促进后续研究。

title: Kosmo-GFM: A Production-Ready Geometry Foundation Model
abstract: We present Kosmo-GFM, a scene reconstruction system that integrates a geometry foundation model (GFM), a pose optimization engine (PoseEngine), and reconstruction-derived supervision from KosmoWorld. GFM predicts camera parameters, depth, cross-view correspondences, and dynamic 3D points from images and videos. PoseEngine combines these predictions with geometric optimization to recover scene-level camera poses and geometry for downstream 3D and 4D Gaussian Splatting. KosmoWorld generates images and geometric supervision from reconstructed real-world scenes to improve GFM's geometric predictions. On the Sparse and Medium subsets of SpatialBench, GFM achieves the lowest absolute relative depth error and the highest relative-pose AUC at 5 degrees among the compared methods. It also achieves the lowest mean endpoint errors for dynamic points and scene flow across the five evaluated datasets. Across 34 scenes completed by all compared reconstruction systems, PoseEngine achieves the highest scene-averaged pose AUC at thresholds of 1, 3, and 5 degrees, with a cumulative runtime of 14.07 hours, approximately 20% of GLUEMAP's 69.67 hours. PoseEngine Flash provides a further accuracy-efficiency trade-off, with a measured mixed-precision runtime of 2.62 hours, approximately 4% of GLUEMAP's runtime. Separate scaling experiments show generally favorable trends with increased data, model computation, and training budgets. These results support the use of learned geometric priors within a scene-level reconstruction pipeline.
tldr: Kosmo-GFM 整合几何基础模型、位姿优化引擎与重建监督，实现高精度高效场景重建。
motivation: 针对场景级三维/四维重建中相机位姿与几何恢复的精度和效率难题，论文提出可生产部署的几何基础模型系统，旨在用学习到的几何先验增强重建流程。
method: GFM 从图像/视频预测相机参数、深度、跨视角对应和动态三维点；PoseEngine 将这些预测与几何优化结合，恢复场景级相机位姿与几何，供 3D/4D Gaussian Splatting 使用；KosmoWorld 从重建的真实场景生成图像与几何监督，反向提升 GFM 的几何预测。
result: 在 SpatialBench 的 Sparse 和 Medium 子集上，GFM 取得最低绝对相对深度误差和最高 5° 相对位姿 AUC；在五个数据集上取得最低动态点与场景流平均端点误差。34 个场景中 PoseEngine 在 1°/3°/5° 阈值下场景平均位姿 AUC 最高，累计运行 14.07 小时，约为 GLUEMAP 69.67 小时的 20%；PoseEngine Flash 混合精度运行 2.62 小时，约为其 4%。
conclusion: 结果表明学习几何先验可用于场景级重建流水线，并在精度与效率间取得优势；系统具备生产可用性，对 3D/4D 重建与 Gaussian Splatting 下游任务有潜在影响。

title: Reconstruct What You Can: Distractor-free 4D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Dynamic reconstruction from casual video must preserve valid subject motion while suppressing transient occluders, shadows, and volumetric effects. Existing methods either suppress valid motion through static-scene assumptions or model all observations jointly, producing ghosting and unstable geometry. We introduce ReCan-GS, a 4D Gaussian Splatting framework that separates coherent scene content from inconsistent observations. It derives a Jacobian-based deformation-sensitivity score from the learned deformation field, using it as an empirical proxy for reconstruction ambiguity. The score guides separation into dynamic Core Gaussians and per-view Distractor Gaussians, or post-hoc pruning of sensitive Core Gaussians. The same criterion supports removal of spatial occluders, photometric artifacts, and evolving smoke or fog without masks, pretrained segmenters, or medium-specific supervision. Experiments on synthetic and real dynamic scenes and synthetic smoke/fog scenes demonstrate its usefulness across the evaluated distractor regimes.
tldr: ReCan-GS利用形变敏感度分离动态核心与干扰高斯，实现无掩码的干扰物去除4D重建。
motivation: 随意视频的动态重建需保留有效主体运动，同时抑制瞬态遮挡、阴影和体积效应。现有方法要么以静态场景假设压制有效运动，要么联合建模所有观测，导致鬼影和几何不稳定。
method: 提出ReCan-GS 4D高斯泼溅框架，从学习到的形变场推导基于Jacobian的形变敏感度分数，作为重建歧义的经验代理。该分数指导将场景分离为动态Core Gaussians与逐视图Distractor Gaussians，或对敏感Core Gaussians进行事后剪枝；同一准则无需掩码、预训练分割器或介质特定监督即可去除空间遮挡、光度伪影及演化烟雾/雾。
result: 在合成与真实动态场景以及合成烟雾/雾场景上的实验表明，该方法在所评估的干扰物情形下具有有效性；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: ReCan-GS通过形变敏感度统一分离一致场景内容与不一致观测，为无需额外掩码和预训练分割器的鲁棒4D重建提供了新思路。其潜在影响在于提升随意视频动态重建对多种干扰物的适应性与几何稳定性。

title: GOOSELoc: A Multimodal Benchmark for Ground-to-Aerial Localization in Unstructured Off-Road Terrain
abstract: Cross-view pose estimation estimates a ground camera's geographic pose by matching onboard sensor data with geo-referenced overhead imagery. This is particularly relevant when GNSS is unreliable, for example under forest canopy or in urban canyons. Existing metric cross-view benchmarks, such as VIGOR and cross-view KITTI, are dominated by urban and road scenes with strong human-made structure without off-road terrain. We introduce GOOSELoc, a multimodal benchmark for ground-to-aerial localization in unstructured environments, including forests, fields, and rural tracks. GOOSELoc comprises 9,356 scenes recorded across all four seasons around Munich, Germany, pairing geo-referenced aerial orthophotos with surround-view RGB imagery and 3D LiDAR point clouds. Paved/unpaved labels enable analyzing the impact of terrain structure, while the seasonal recordings allow studying the appearance gap to mostly summer-captured orthophotos. To assess the transferability of existing methods, we adapt and fine-tune four state-of-the-art cross-view localization baselines on GOOSELoc. Despite task-specific fine-tuning, the performance degrades substantially in off-road environments. We therefore propose a multimodal baseline combining surround-view imagery and LiDAR geometry, improving localization performance and providing a stronger reference for future work. Data and baselines are released at https://gooseloc.github.io.
tldr: 提出GOOSELoc非结构化越野地面到空中定位多模态基准，并给出融合环视RGB与LiDAR的基线。
motivation: 现有度量跨视角定位基准多集中于城市和道路等强人造结构场景，缺乏森林、田野和乡村小径等非结构化越野环境；在GNSS不可靠时，此类环境的地面到空中定位需求突出。
method: 构建GOOSELoc基准，包含德国慕尼黑周边四季录制的9,356个场景，配对地理参考航拍正射影像、环视RGB图像和3D LiDAR点云，并提供铺装/非铺装标签以分析地形结构影响及季节外观差异。适配并微调四种先进跨视角定位基线，同时提出融合环视图像与LiDAR几何的多模态基线。
result: 摘要给出9,356个场景、四季覆盖及四种基线微调结果；现有方法即便任务特定微调后在越野环境中性能仍显著下降，所提多模态基线提升定位性能，但未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: GOOSELoc补充了非结构化越野地面到空中定位基准，揭示现有方法迁移性不足，并提供更强的多模态参考基线；数据和基线已公开，有望推动鲁棒跨视角定位研究。

title: Topology-Aware 4D Gaussian Splatting for Egocentric Videos
abstract: Reconstructing dynamic scenes and objects from monocular egocentric video is crucial for embodied AI, yet existing 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) approaches struggle with everyday interactions involving topological changes, such as cutting, assembly, opening, or closing. Since 4DGS methods rely on deforming a fixed representation, events that split, merge, or reveal surfaces cause severe visual artifacts. To address this challenge, we introduce TopoEgo, the first benchmark dedicated to topological changes in egocentric video (covering fission, fusion, open, and close), alongside Topo-4DGS, a topology-aware reconstruction method. Topo4DGS jointly models part-level motion and time-varying surface support by assigning independent rigid transformations to interacting parts and dynamically activating or deactivating Gaussians as surfaces appear, disappear, or separate. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Topo-4DGS significantly outperforms state-of-the-art 4DGS approaches across topological changes, especially on post-event frames. Code and data will be made publicly available.
tldr: 提出TopoEgo基准与Topo-4DGS，用部件级刚体运动与高斯动态激活/停用重建含拓扑变化的自我中心视频。
motivation: 单目自我中心视频中的切割、装配、开合等交互会引发分裂、合并或表面显露等拓扑变化；现有4DGS依赖对固定表示的形变，难以处理此类事件并产生严重伪影。
method: 构建首个面向自我中心视频拓扑变化的TopoEgo基准（覆盖fission、fusion、open、close），并提出Topo-4DGS：为交互部件分配独立刚体变换以建模部件级运动，同时随时间动态激活或停用高斯以表达表面的出现、消失与分离。
result: 实验显示Topo-4DGS在多种拓扑变化场景下显著优于当前4DGS方法，事件后帧尤为明显；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 该工作为含拓扑变化的动态场景重建提供了新基准与方法，通过解耦部件运动与时变表面支撑提升重建鲁棒性，对具身AI中的交互理解与仿真具有潜在影响。

title: SCR-Mamba: Skeleton-conditioned Mamba with cross-scale incremental refinement for efficient 3D human pose estimation
abstract: Mamba-based methods for video-based 3D human pose estimation can model long sequences with linear complexity, but their selective state updates usually lack direct exploitation of skeletal relations. Meanwhile, stacking modeling blocks at the full temporal resolution leads to high computational overhead, while compressing the temporal sequence makes it difficult to retain per-frame details. To address these issues, we propose SCR-Mamba, whose core consists of Skeleton-Conditioned State Modeling (SCSM) and Cross-Scale Incremental Refinement (CSIR). SCSM generates a skeleton context from bone connections and left-right symmetry relations and generates the selective parameters of the spatial and temporal branches conditioned on it, so that structural relations are involved in the writing, propagation, and reading of state information. CSIR constructs multi-scale motion representations through content-adaptive aggregation and progressively refines the retained per-frame features with the increments produced by coarse-scale modeling, integrating long-range motion context while reducing full-resolution computation. On Human3.6M with Stacked Hourglass (SH) 2D detections and 243-frame inputs, SCR-Mamba-L achieves 36.8 mm MPJPE (P1) with 7.72 M parameters and 15.10 G MACs, less than 1/7 of the computational cost of StructMamPose-L with similar accuracy; SCR-Mamba-X further reaches 36.6 mm P1 and 30.9 mm P-MPJPE (P2), achieving state-of-the-art performance. On MPI-INF-3DHP, SCR-Mamba-X achieves a percentage of correct keypoints (PCK) of 99.3%, an area under the curve (AUC) of 88.1%, and an MPJPE of 14.2 mm.
tldr: SCR-Mamba通过骨骼条件状态建模与跨尺度增量细化，高效提升视频3D人体姿态估计精度。
motivation: 现有基于Mamba的视频3D人体姿态估计虽能以线性复杂度建模长序列，但其选择性状态更新未直接利用骨骼关系；同时，全时间分辨率堆叠建模块计算开销高，而压缩时间序列又难以保留逐帧细节。
method: 提出SCR-Mamba，核心包括骨骼条件状态建模（SCSM）与跨尺度增量细化（CSIR）。SCSM从骨骼连接和左右对称关系生成骨骼上下文，并以其为条件生成时空分支的选择性参数，使结构关系参与状态信息的写入、传播与读取；CSIR通过内容自适应聚合构建多尺度运动表示，并用粗尺度建模产生的增量逐步细化保留的逐帧特征，在整合长程运动上下文的同时降低全分辨率计算。
result: 在Human3.6M上使用Stacked Hourglass（SH）2D检测和243帧输入时，SCR-Mamba-L取得36.8 mm MPJPE（P1）、7.72 M参数和15.10 G MACs，计算量不足StructMamPose-L的1/7且精度相近；SCR-Mamba-X进一步达到36.6 mm P1和30.9 mm P-MPJPE（P2），取得state-of-the-art性能。在MPI-INF-3DHP上，SCR-Mamba-X取得99.3% PCK、88.1% AUC和14.2 mm MPJPE。
conclusion: SCR-Mamba将骨骼结构先验注入Mamba状态建模，并通过跨尺度增量细化显著降低全分辨率计算，在多个指标上实现高效且领先的3D人体姿态估计性能。

title: ThermalSplat: Generalizable Pose-Free Gaussian Splatting for Sparse-View Thermal 3D Reconstruction
abstract: Thermal infrared imaging is vital for applications like search-and-rescue and autonomous navigation, yet trans- lating it into 3D scene representations remains a critical bottleneck. The low-texture nature and view-dependent emissivity of thermal images cause standard pose estima- tors to fail catastrophically, collapsing standard 3D Gaus- sian Splatting pipelines under sparse-view constraints. Fur- thermore, existing thermal reconstruction methods rely heavily on dense capture and computationally expensive per-scene optimization. Critically, many of these ap- proaches depend on aligned RGB-thermal datasets to ob- tain reliable camera poses and initial point clouds, ren- dering them unusable in purely thermal, unposed envi- ronments. To break this bottleneck, we present Thermal- Splat, the first generalizable, feed-forward Gaussian splat- ting framework that reconstructs 3D scenes directly from sparse thermal images without requiring known camera poses, RGB guidance, or per-scene training. We over- come thermal-specific challenges using a soft census loss for brightness-invariant structural matching and a bound- ary structure loss to explicitly supervise temperature discon- tinuities. Trained on an aggregated multi-source dataset, ThermalSplat synthesizes sharp reconstructions of unseen scenes in a single feed-forward pass. Extensive experi- ments demonstrate that ThermalSplat holds a strict advan- tage over scene-specific thermal splatting methods in the sparse regime. Furthermore, even compared against these baselines operating under their ideal dense capture set- tings, ThermalSplat achieves superior perceptual fidelity. By eliminating the need for computationally expensive per scene optimization, ThermalSplat offers an efficient and generalizable approach to thermal 3D reconstruction.
tldr: ThermalSplat 是无需位姿/RGB 的稀疏热成像前馈 Gaussian Splatting 通用三维重建框架。
motivation: 热红外成像在搜救与自主导航中很重要，但低纹理和视角相关发射率会使标准位姿估计失败，稀疏视角下 3D Gaussian Splatting 易崩溃；现有热重建方法依赖密集采集、逐场景优化及对齐 RGB-热数据，难以用于纯热、无位姿环境。
method: 提出 ThermalSplat，首个可泛化的前馈 Gaussian Splatting 框架，直接从稀疏热图像重建三维场景，无需已知相机位姿、RGB 引导或逐场景训练；采用 soft census loss 进行亮度不变的结构匹配，并用 boundary structure loss 显式监督温度不连续边界。
result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标；实验表明 ThermalSplat 在稀疏视角下严格优于场景特定热成像 splatting 方法，并且即使对比这些基线在理想密集采集设置下的表现，也能取得更优的感知保真度。
conclusion: ThermalSplat 消除了计算昂贵的逐场景优化，为纯热、无位姿三维重建提供了高效且可泛化的方案，有望推动搜救与自主导航等热红外应用。

title: IncR-3DSGG: Incremental Posed RGB Image Based 3D Scene Graph Generation via Privileged Depth Supervision
abstract: Scene graphs provide a compact, structured representation of environments by capturing objects and their spatial or semantic relationships in a form suitable for embodied agents. Existing 3D scene graph generation methods often rely on depth sensing at inference, either to associate object instances across views via point cloud overlap or to compute inter-object relations from geometric cues, limiting deployment to platforms with depth sensors. We propose IncR-3DSGG, which builds 3D scene graphs incrementally from posed\footnote{RGB images with camera extrinsics estimated by an off-the-shelf visual SLAM system.} RGB images, eliminating the use of depth sensors at inference. Our method leverages a Parametric Relation Predictor (PRP) that learns to estimate pairwise distances and relative angles between objects from 2D visual features and 2D geometric cues, using 3D geometric supervision available only during training. These learned pairwise measurements are fused across views through Pose Graph Optimization (PGO)~\cite{grisetti2010tutorial} to recover metrically grounded 3D object positions and build a globally consistent 3D scene graph incrementally. On the real-world 3RScan~\cite{wald2019rio} dataset, our method attains $52.2$ mean object recall and $30.8$ mean predicate recall under the 3DSSG~\cite{wald2020learning} evaluation protocol, against $27.0$ and $17.6$ for MonoSSG~\cite{wu2023incremental}, while using no depth or reconstructed geometry at inference. This shows that relations and metrically grounded 3D object representations can be predicted from posed RGB images alone.
tldr: IncR-3DSGG 仅用带位姿 RGB 图像增量构建三维场景图，训练时用深度监督，推理无需深度传感器。
motivation: 现有三维场景图生成方法在推理阶段依赖深度传感器，用于跨视角实例关联或几何关系计算，限制了在仅 RGB 平台上的部署。本文旨在仅利用带位姿 RGB 图像和视觉 SLAM 提供的相机外参，增量构建度量一致的三维场景图。
method: 提出参数化关系预测器 PRP，从二维视觉特征与二维几何线索估计物体间距离和相对角度，训练时仅使用三维几何监督。将跨视角预测的成对测量通过位姿图优化 PGO 融合，恢复具有度量尺度的三维物体位置，并增量构建全局一致的三维场景图。
result: 在真实数据集 3RScan 上，按 3DSSG 评估协议取得 52.2 平均物体召回率和 30.8 平均谓词召回率，显著高于 MonoSSG 的 27.0 和 17.6；且推理阶段不使用深度或重建几何。
conclusion: 结果表明，仅凭带位姿 RGB 图像即可预测物体间关系并获得具有度量基础的三维物体表示，为无深度传感器平台的增量三维场景图构建提供了可行方案。

title: MatrixSplat: Matrix-Parallel and Feature-Scalable 3D Gaussian Splatting Rendering on GPUs
abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has emerged as a mainstream representation for real-time novel view synthesis and 3D reconstruction. However, existing 3DGS rendering pipelines are poorly aligned with modern GPU architectures: depth-sorted alpha compositing introduces strong per-pixel sequential dependencies, limiting parallelism and resulting in scalar FMA-dominated execution that underutilizes high-throughput matrix units such as Tensor Cores. This mismatch becomes more severe for multimodal and semantically enriched 3DGS, where high-dimensional features must be accumulated from millions of Gaussians, leading to rapidly increasing computation and memory costs. We propose MatrixSplat, a matrix-parallel rendering framework for feature-scalable 3DGS on modern GPUs. We first identify the sequential dependency of alpha compositing as a key obstacle to efficient high-dimensional feature rendering, and adopt an order-independent weighted accumulation formulation that transforms feature rendering into matrix-oriented computation. Our framework features three key designs: (i) a tile-based splatting pipeline that maps feature accumulation to warp-level matrix-multiply-accumulate execution on Tensor Cores; (ii) a warp-granularity Gaussian packing strategy that mitigates visibility irregularity and improves feature reuse; and (iii) a lazy channel-batched feature-fetching pipeline that reduces shared-memory pressure, maintains high warp occupancy, and overlaps memory access with matrix execution for high-dimensional features. On Mip-NeRF 360, LERF, and 3D-OVS, MatrixSplat achieves up to 3.8$\times$ speedup over 3DGS and 2$\times$ over TC-GS while maintaining rendering quality and semantic accuracy, and further reduces render-kernel time by up to 36.7$\times$ for high-dimensional features. Integrated into existing fast renderers, it provides an additional 1.69-2.84$\times$ speedup.
tldr: MatrixSplat将3DGS特征渲染转化为矩阵并行计算，在Tensor Cores上实现高维特征可扩展渲染。
motivation: 现有3DGS渲染管线依赖深度排序的alpha合成，导致逐像素强顺序依赖，限制并行度并形成以标量FMA为主的执行模式，难以利用Tensor Cores等高吞吐矩阵单元。对于多模态和语义增强3DGS，需从数百万高斯中累积高维特征，计算与内存开销进一步急剧增加。
method: MatrixSplat采用与顺序无关的加权累积公式，将特征渲染转化为面向矩阵的计算。其核心设计包括：基于tile的splatting管线，将特征累积映射为Tensor Cores上的warp级矩阵乘加执行；warp粒度的高斯打包策略，缓解可见性不规则并提升特征复用；惰性通道分批特征读取管线，降低共享内存压力、维持高warp占用率，并将内存访问与矩阵执行重叠。
result: 在Mip-NeRF 360、LERF和3D-OVS上，MatrixSplat相比3DGS最高取得3.8倍加速，相比TC-GS取得2倍加速，同时保持渲染质量与语义准确率；对于高维特征，渲染内核时间最高降低36.7倍。集成到现有快速渲染器后，还可额外提供1.69-2.84倍加速。
conclusion: MatrixSplat通过矩阵并行与特征可扩展设计，有效将3DGS高维特征渲染对齐到现代GPU矩阵单元，显著提升语义/多模态3DGS渲染效率。其方法可集成至现有快速渲染器，对实时高维特征3DGS应用具有潜在影响。

title: Multi-View 3D Reconstruction Using V-JEPA Features
abstract: Predictive video encoders provide dense visual representations, but adapting them to 3D reconstruction requires accurate depth, camera poses, and cross-view geometry. We study supervised RGB-only multi-view reconstruction using an architecture that combines video-pretrained features, camera estimation, scene aggregation, epipolar transport, and residual pointmaps. Experiments compare global and spatial camera regression with joint relative objectives on CO3D, alongside an independently trained TUM RGB-D model. On 168 CO3D five-view windows, the spatial-camera configuration achieves 29.3% lower absolute trajectory error than the global-camera configuration, but performs worse than identity poses in trajectory error and worse than the global configuration in depth error. The joint relative-objective configuration improves normalized intrinsics error and similarity-aligned Chamfer distance from 0.6447 to 0.5573, but increases raw Chamfer distance from 3.5535 to 4.4374. On 163 indoor windows, camera error is 0.3063 m versus 0.3694 m for identity poses, while depth error is 0.4279 versus 0.2516 for constant median depth. Refinement worsens indoor camera error, and additional experiments show competing depth and pose effects. Overall, the results distinguish representation adaptation, aligned shape, and raw reconstruction, highlighting the need for isolated component and encoder comparisons before attributing reconstruction gains to predictive video pretraining.
tldr: 该文用V-JEPA特征构建RGB多视图重建架构，并在CO3D与TUM上揭示相机配置和联合目标的深度-位姿权衡。
motivation: 预测视频编码器能提供稠密视觉表示，但适配到仅RGB多视图3D重建仍依赖准确深度、相机位姿与跨视图几何。作者希望厘清重建收益究竟来自表示适配、对齐形状还是原始重建，并判断是否可归因于预测视频预训练。
method: 提出一种监督式RGB-only多视图重建架构，融合V-JEPA视频预训练特征、相机估计、场景聚合、极线传输与残差pointmaps。在CO3D上比较全局相机回归、空间相机回归和联合相对目标，并在TUM RGB-D上独立训练模型进行室内验证。
result: 在168个CO3D五视图窗口上，空间相机配置较全局配置绝对轨迹误差低29.3%，但轨迹误差劣于identity poses、深度误差劣于全局配置；联合相对目标将归一化内参误差和相似对齐Chamfer距离从0.6447降至0.5573，却使原始Chamfer距离从3.5535升至4.4374。在163个室内窗口上，相机误差为0.3063 m，优于identity poses的0.3694 m；深度误差为0.4279，劣于constant median depth的0.2516。
conclusion: 结果表明需区分表示适配、对齐形状与原始重建三类指标，并强调在将重建增益归因于预测视频预训练前，应进行隔离的组件与编码器比较。额外实验还显示深度与位姿效果存在竞争，refinement会恶化室内相机误差。

title: FastWild-GS: Minutes-Scale In-the-Wild Gaussian Splatting via Compact Per-Image Appearance Adaptation
abstract: Internet photos of a scene differ in exposure, illumination and transient objects such as passers-by, so one set of Gaussian colours cannot explain all photos (the in-the-wild setting). Recent in-the-wild Gaussian Splatting methods mostly report hours of per-scene optimization. We present FastWild-GS, which describes each photo by a 128-dimensional Photo Appearance Token and a per-channel transform, a scale and an offset applied to the rendered image (six parameters); a small MLP predicts the colour of each Gaussian from this token and a per-Gaussian feature, replacing the spherical-harmonics colour. The same transform is applied to the renders that score Gaussians for densification and pruning, so appearance differences between photos are not counted as reconstruction error. On PhotoTourism, FastWild-GS trains in 8.8 minutes per scene with the lowest LPIPS among the compared methods, 23x faster than AsymGS, the next best in LPIPS. On NeRF-OSR, it has the best average PSNR, SSIM and LPIPS among the compared methods in 9.7 minutes per scene.
tldr: FastWild-GS用128维图像外观令牌和6参数逐通道变换建模照片外观，在PhotoTourism和NeRF-OSR上以分钟级训练取得最低LPIPS或最佳综合指标。
motivation: 互联网照片存在曝光、光照和行人等瞬态物体差异，单一高斯颜色无法解释所有照片；现有野外高斯泼溅方法通常需每场景数小时优化。
method: 为每张照片引入128维Photo Appearance Token和渲染图的逐通道缩放/偏移共6参数变换，用小MLP由该令牌和逐高斯特征预测颜色以替代球谐颜色；同一变换也用于致密化与剪枝时的渲染评分，避免把照片间外观差异误计为重建误差。
result: 在PhotoTourism上每场景训练8.8分钟，LPIPS为对比方法最低，比LPIPS次优的AsymGS快23倍；在NeRF-OSR上每场景9.7分钟，平均PSNR、SSIM和LPIPS均为对比方法最佳。
conclusion: 表明紧凑的逐图像外观适配可在分钟级完成野外高斯泼溅训练，并在多个指标上优于或媲美现有方法；通过解耦照片外观与几何/光度评分，为互联网照片的三维重建与新视角合成提供高效方案。

title: Marrying Capacity and Precision for Efficient 2D Gaussian Image Representation
abstract: 2D Gaussian representations provide an explicit and efficient way to represent images, but their rate-distortion performance under limited budgets depends critically on how Gaussian capacity and parameter precision are allocated. Existing methods typically optimize these two resources separately, overlooking content-dependent capacity demands and heterogeneous quantization sensitivity. We present CP-GS, a capacity-precision coupled Gaussian splatting framework for budget-aware 2D Gaussian image representation that jointly optimizes capacity allocation and attribute precision under a shared rate constraint. CP-GS first constructs a content-adaptive Gaussian representation by dynamically reallocating a fixed Gaussian budget from redundant regions to areas with higher representation demand. It then introduces hierarchical distortion-aware representation quantization, using efficient rendering-based calibration to allocate precision across Gaussian attributes and further refine it within heterogeneous attribute groups. Finally, it jointly optimizes Gaussian capacity and attribute precision by constructing candidate representations with different Gaussian counts and precision configurations and selecting operating points according to decoded distortion and actual serialized size. Experiments on DIV2K and Kodak show that CP-GS achieves improved rate-distortion performance over representative 2D Gaussian and implicit neural representations across a range of budgets, while maintaining a fixed overall representation budget and low optimization cost. These results demonstrate the benefit of jointly optimizing spatial capacity and parameter precision for compact Gaussian image representation.
tldr: CP-GS联合优化2D高斯容量分配与参数精度，在统一码率预算下提升率失真性能。
motivation: 现有2D高斯图像表示通常分别优化高斯容量与参数精度，忽略了内容依赖的容量需求和不同属性的异构量化敏感性，导致有限预算下率失真性能次优。
method: CP-GS先根据内容自适应地将固定高斯预算从冗余区域重分配到表示需求更高的区域；再采用分层失真感知量化，通过高效渲染校准为不同高斯属性分配精度并在异构属性组内细化；最后联合搜索不同高斯数量与精度配置，依据解码失真和实际序列化大小选择工作点。
result: 在DIV2K和Kodak数据集上，CP-GS在多种预算下相比代表性2D高斯表示和隐式神经表示取得更优的率失真性能，同时保持固定总表示预算并具有较低优化成本。
conclusion: 结果表明联合优化空间容量与参数精度有助于实现紧凑的2D高斯图像表示，为预算感知的高斯表示资源分配提供了有效方案。

title: RF3DGS: Reflection-Free 3D Gaussian Splatting with Self-Priors
abstract: 3D reflection removal is crucial in applications demanding high-fidelity visualization, such as museum exhibitions. In this work, we propose Reflection-Free 3D Gaussian Splatting (RF3DGS), a novel method for superior reflection removal. RF3DGS exclusively leverages a widely-adopted photometric prior for reflection removal: that the minimum pixel intensity across multi-view images corresponding to the same 3D point strongly correlates with reflection-free information. However, generalizing this principle to a 3D Gaussian Splatting within a multi-view context is non-trivial. To address this, RF3DGS first optimizes a vanilla 3DGS model using a geometric prior to estimate a coarse, reflection-free depth map for each view. Leveraging these depth maps and photometric prior, a 3D warping process aggregates reflection-free information from auxiliary views to construct a clean transmission pseudo-label for a given reference view. This pseudo-label provides a robust self-supervised signal for optimization. We further introduce an Adaptive Twin Rendering (ATR) loss to synergistically utilize this pseudo-label while preserving high-frequency details from the original, reflection-degraded images. By adeptly fusing these internal 3D self-priors with the ATR loss, RF3DGS demonstrates state-of-the-art reflection removal performance across both synthetic and real-world scenarios. Furthermore, we establish the first 3D reflection removal benchmark, based on the Unity rendering engine, for rigorous quantitative evaluation.
tldr: 提出RF3DGS，利用多视角光度先验与自适应双渲染损失实现无反射3DGS重建。
motivation: 3D反射去除对博物馆展览等高保真可视化应用至关重要，但将“同一3D点多视角图像的最小像素强度与无反射信息强相关”这一光度先验推广到多视角3D Gaussian Splatting并非易事。
method: RF3DGS先用几何先验优化普通3DGS，估计每个视角的粗粒度无反射深度图；再结合深度图与光度先验，通过3D warping从辅助视角聚合无反射信息，为参考视角构建干净的透射伪标签以提供自监督信号；同时引入Adaptive Twin Rendering (ATR)损失，在利用伪标签的同时保留原始反射退化图像中的高频细节。
result: 在合成与真实场景中均取得state-of-the-art的反射去除性能；并基于Unity渲染引擎建立了首个3D反射去除基准，用于严格定量评估，摘要未提供具体数值指标。
conclusion: RF3DGS通过融合内部3D自先验与ATR损失，有效实现无反射3D重建并保持细节，同时填补了3D反射去除定量基准的空白，对高保真3D可视化应用具有推动作用。

title: CJRR-Net: A Candidate-Joint Reprojection Ranking for Future-View Selection in Human Pose Estimation
abstract: Multi-camera systems support performance recording, sports and human-movement analysis, where selecting an informative viewpoint is important for reliable human pose estimation. We propose the Candidate-Joint Reprojection Ranking Network (CJRR-Net) for future-view selection among eight calibrated cameras in MPI-INF-3DHP. The model combines current-view pose observations, camera configuration, and candidate-specific geometric features obtained by reprojecting the estimated 3D pose and its uncertainty into each candidate view. CJRR-Net achieves a selected-view 2D mean per-joint position error (MPJPE) of 105.18 pixels, compared with 114.64 pixels for the shared-input MLP and 117.56 pixels for adapted PoseErrNet. It also achieves the lowest mean error among the listed policies in each evaluated occlusion group. A blender rollout illustrates repeated camera selection. These findings support candidate-specific geometry for single-view selection in the evaluated fixed eight-camera setting.
tldr: CJRR-Net利用候选视角重投影几何与不确定性排序，为多相机人体姿态估计选择未来视角。
motivation: 多相机系统常用于运动记录与人体运动分析，选择信息量高的视角对可靠人体姿态估计至关重要；现有共享输入方法未充分利用每个候选视角特有的几何信息。
method: 提出CJRR-Net，将当前视角姿态观测、相机配置，以及把估计3D姿态及其不确定性重投影到各候选视角得到的候选特定几何特征相结合，对MPI-INF-3DHP中八个标定相机进行未来视角排序与选择。
result: 所选视角的2D MPJPE为105.18像素，优于shared-input MLP的114.64像素和adapted PoseErrNet的117.56像素；在各遮挡分组中平均误差均为所列策略最低，并用Blender rollout展示重复相机选择过程。
conclusion: 结果表明候选特定几何有助于固定八相机设置下的单视角选择，可支持多相机人体姿态估计中的视角规划；结论主要适用于所评估的标定相机场景。

title: DepthGS: Depth-Guided Gaussian Splatting with Adaptive Regularization for High-Quality Surface Reconstruction
abstract: Recently, 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has emerged as an efficient representation for novel view synthesis, offering fast differentiable rendering and high visual fidelity, and has increasingly been extended to surface reconstruction. However, the relationship between depth information and reconstruction error remains insufficiently explored, limiting the principled design of geometric optimization strategies. To fill the above gap, we propose DepthGS, a depth-guided Gaussian splatting framework. We derive theoretical relations between depth discrepancies and reconstruction error under single-view and multi-view settings, and rigorously establish corresponding upper bounds on reconstruction error. The above analysis informs the design of adaptive regularization strategies in both single-view and multi-view optimization. More specifically, for single-view optimization, we propose a depth-difference-guided adaptive normal regularization strategy that modulates the normal constraint strength using a geometric reliability weight computed from local depth differences. For multi-view optimization, we introduce a cross-view depth consistency regularization strategy that promotes consistency between neighboring-view depth maps and the corresponding depth predictions obtained by transforming the current view's depth predictions into those neighboring views. Extensive experiments on DTU, Mip-NeRF360, and Tanks and Temples demonstrate that DepthGS achieves competitive performance in both surface reconstruction and novel view synthesis.
tldr: DepthGS通过理论分析深度差异与重建误差的关系，设计单视图与多视图自适应正则化，提升3DGS表面重建质量。
motivation: 3D Gaussian Splatting虽能高效实现高质量新视角合成，但深度信息与重建误差之间的关系尚未被充分探索，限制了几何优化策略的原则性设计。该工作旨在填补这一空白，为基于深度的表面重建正则化提供理论依据。
method: DepthGS推导单视图与多视图设置下深度差异与重建误差之间的理论关系，并严格建立重建误差上界。基于该分析，单视图优化采用由局部深度差异计算几何可靠性权重的深度差引导自适应法向正则化；多视图优化引入跨视图深度一致性正则化，促使相邻视图深度图与当前视图深度预测变换到相邻视图后的深度预测保持一致。
result: 在DTU、Mip-NeRF360和Tanks and Temples上的大量实验表明，DepthGS在表面重建和新视角合成两方面均取得有竞争力的性能；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: DepthGS建立了深度差异与重建误差之间的理论联系，并据此设计单视图和多视图自适应正则化策略，在保持3DGS渲染效率与视觉质量的同时提升表面重建几何质量，为高质量3DGS表面重建提供了有理论支撑的优化思路。

title: Lightweight Deep Learning Framework for Astrocyte-Centric 3D Reconstruction across Normal and Stress-associated Ultrastructural States
abstract: The morphology of astrocytes is closely associated with their ability to support and modulate neural circuit functions; however, its reconstruction from volume electron microscopy (vEM) data remains labor-intensive and computationally resource-intensive, placing substantial barriers on its broader adoption and scalability despite the high spatial resolution of vEM. We present AstroSeg-vEM, a lightweight, astrocyte-centric framework for morphology-preserving astrocyte segmentation, 3D reconstruction, and quantitative morphological analysis in vEM images. AstroSeg-vEM combines transformer-based 2D segmentation with dedicated post-processing methods and operates directly on high-resolution EM sections, making it well suited to anisotropic vEM data and downstream proofreading workflows while preserving the full in-plane resolution of the original EM data. Across four mouse hippocampal datasets representing normal and morphologically defined stress-associated astrocyte ultrastructural states, AstroSeg-vEM demonstrates robust performance and generalization, achieving average Dice and weighted Dice values of 0.92 and 0.95, respectively, on a held-out test dataset. Its lightweight architecture enables efficient, high-fidelity reconstruction on consumer-grade hardware, providing a scalable and accessible platform for large-scale astrocyte ultrastructure analysis and future astrocyte-neuron interaction studies.
tldr: 提出轻量级 AstroSeg-vEM 框架，实现 vEM 中星形胶质细胞分割、三维重建与形态定量分析。
motivation: 星形胶质细胞形态与其支持和调控神经环路功能密切相关，但从体积电子显微镜（vEM）数据中重建其形态仍耗时且计算资源需求高，限制了高分辨率 vEM 的广泛应用与规模化分析。
method: AstroSeg-vEM 将基于 transformer 的二维分割与专门的后处理方法结合，直接在高分辨率 EM 切片上运行，适配各向异性 vEM 数据和下游校对流程，并保留原始 EM 数据的完整面内分辨率。
result: 在代表正常和形态学定义的压力相关星形胶质细胞超微结构状态的四个小鼠海马数据集上，AstroSeg-vEM 表现出稳健性能和泛化能力，在留出测试集上平均 Dice 和加权 Dice 分别达到 0.92 和 0.95；其轻量架构可在消费级硬件上高效完成高保真重建。
conclusion: 该工作提供了一个可扩展、易获取的平台，用于大规模星形胶质细胞超微结构分析及未来星形胶质细胞-神经元相互作用研究。

title: GEMOR-GS: Global Extrinsic-calibration-refined Mapping and Online Relocalization for 3D Gaussian-Splatting SLAM
abstract: Photorealistic and metrically consistent world representations are a primary requirement for LiDAR--inertial--visual SLAM systems that serve robots over continuous operation. 3D Gaussian splatting makes such representations attainable by supplying an explicit, renderable, and queryable scene model. We present GEMOR-GS (Global Extrinsic-calibration-refined Mapping and Online Relocalization for 3D Gaussian-Splatting SLAM) to make the Gaussian map geometrically accurate, globally refined, and re-enterable, providing a better appearance for robot perception and decision-making. To improve the 3DGS map, the LiDAR--camera extrinsic is first estimated offline by direct-method alignment over dedicated calibration segments and reused by all following online and offline processes. Under the calibrated geometry, keyframe poses and Gaussian parameters are refined alternately under a gated differentiable-rendering and LiDAR--projection objective. The final global reconstruction is then rebuilt from the refined keyframe schema with all online constraints lifted. For the robot SLAM lifecycle, the method recovers the pose from the 3DGS map after tracking loss through an XFeat bypass map, RANSAC-PnP coarse localization, and Gaussian RGB-D warp refinement. Experiments on one self-collected and five public sequences quantify each element: the offline reconstruction wins all paired keyframes against the online map by 14.3--19.9 dB, improves PSNR by approximately 9 dB over Gaussian-LIC2, and achieves 86--100% held-out relocalization success tied to extrinsic quality. The results show that GEMOR-GS improves the geometric accuracy, appearance fidelity, and re-enterability of the 3DGS map, serving as a dependable robot world model for SLAM and downstream tasks.
tldr: GEMOR-GS通过离线外参标定与全局建图优化，提升3DGS SLAM地图几何/外观并实现在线重定位。
motivation: 面向机器人持续运行的LiDAR-惯性-视觉SLAM需要逼真且度量一致的世界表示；3DGS虽提供显式、可渲染、可查询的场景模型，但地图仍需几何准确、全局精炼并支持跟踪丢失后的重新进入。
method: 先利用专用标定段以直接法离线估计LiDAR-相机外参，并在后续在线与离线流程中复用；在标定几何下，以门控的可微渲染与LiDAR投影目标交替优化关键帧位姿和高斯参数，再在解除在线约束后由精炼关键帧模式重建全局地图。重定位采用XFeat旁路地图、RANSAC-PnP粗定位和高斯RGB-D warp细化恢复位姿。
result: 在1个自采和5个公开序列上，离线重建在所有配对关键帧上优于在线地图14.3–19.9 dB，PSNR较Gaussian-LIC2提升约9 dB，留出重定位成功率达86–100%且与外参质量相关。
conclusion: GEMOR-GS提升了3DGS地图的几何精度、外观保真度与可重入性，可作为SLAM及下游任务的可靠机器人世界模型。

title: Camera3R: Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction from Heterogeneous Camera Models
abstract: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction (3R) from unconstrained multi-view images has recently emerged as a prominent research direction in 3D computer vision. Various foundational reconstruction models have been proposed with different architectures and reconstruction paradigms. Despite being trained on large-scale perspective datasets with substantial computational resources, these models generally struggle to generalize to non-perspective images. This limitation hinders their deployment in applications involving arbitrary, unknown, and potentially heterogeneous camera models. To build on the capabilities of existing reconstruction models with minimal retraining, we propose Camera3R, a low-rank adaptation framework that efficiently extends perspective-pretrained 3R networks to any other camera models. Extensive experiments demonstrate that, with only 0.5% additional parameters and less than a day of training, Camera3R adapts a foundational 3D reconstruction model to non-perspective cameras while fully preserving its original performance on perspective inputs. Code is available at https://github.com/android-xr/camera3r.
tldr: Camera3R 用低秩适配将透视预训练的3D重建网络扩展到异构相机模型。
motivation: 现有前馈3D重建模型多在大规模透视图像上训练，难以泛化到非透视及任意未知异构相机模型，限制了实际部署。
method: 提出 Camera3R 低秩适配框架，在透视预训练的3R网络中引入少量可训练低秩参数，以最小重训练将其扩展到任意其他相机模型。
result: 仅增加0.5%参数、训练不足一天，即可将基础3D重建模型适配到非透视相机，同时在透视输入上完全保持原始性能。
conclusion: Camera3R 以极低参数和训练成本实现异构相机模型的3D重建泛化，并可保留透视域能力，利于未知相机场景部署。

title: RECALL: Real-Time Recalibration of Multi-Camera Rigs via Learned OEM-Anchored Residuals
authors: Mario Alberto Tapia de la Cruz
abstract: Multi-camera rigs ship pre-calibrated from the manufacturer, but their calibration goes stale each time the rig is repositioned, and drifts continuously through wear, thermal cycling, and vibration. Recovering it on-the-fly is hard: classical bundle adjustment needs a fresh multi-view capture and a global optimization whose cost grows with the rig, ruling out real-time use. In this paper we present RECALL, a feed-forward method that recalibrates a movable multi-camera rig in a single pass. From the nominal OEM calibration as an anchor and a brief observation of a known object, it predicts each camera's current intrinsics and extrinsics, written as a shared global rotation of the rig composed with a small per-camera drift. Instead of regressing the calibration in one shot, RECALL refines its estimate with a learned, rig-coupled recurrent operator that reprojects through a differentiable projection and applies attention across the cameras at each step, and solves for the shared rotational gauge in-network with a learned Gauss-Newton step rather than regressing it. Because the ground truth is synthesizable, we train entirely on data generated on-the-fly and need no captured dataset. On a synthetic 10-camera benchmark, RECALL is more accurate than per-camera and rig-coupled joint bundle adjustment ($0.26^\circ$ vs $0.47^\circ$ rotation, $5.4$ vs $8.9$ px focal) and runs about $10^5\times$ faster at about $0.12$ ms per rig. On real data (TotalCapture, CMU Panoptic) it matches or beats offline rig-coupled bundle adjustment on absolute and relative rotation while running four-to-five orders of magnitude faster, and on the Panoptic surround rig it also matches the strongest image-only foundation models (VGGT, VGGT-$Ω$, $π^3$) on relative pose while staying metric and about $15\times$ more accurate in focal length. Code: https://github.com/theICTlab/RECALL-multicam
tldr: RECALL 用 OEM 标定锚定与可学习残差单次前向实现多相机实时重标定，速度与精度均优。
motivation: 多相机设备出厂预标定，但重新布置、磨损、热循环和振动会使标定失效或漂移；经典 bundle adjustment 需重新采集多视角并做随相机数量增长的全局优化，难以实时。
method: RECALL 以 OEM 标定为锚，结合对已知物体的短时观测，单次前向预测各相机当前内参和外参，将外参表示为整机共享全局旋转与每相机小漂移的复合。它不直接回归标定，而是用可学习、相机耦合的循环算子迭代精化：通过可微投影重投影并在相机间施加注意力，同时用学习到的 Gauss-Newton 步在网络内求解共享旋转 gauge。由于真值可合成，训练数据全部在线生成，无需采集数据集。
result: 在合成 10 相机基准上，RECALL 的旋转误差为 0.26°（优于 0.47°），焦距误差 5.4 px（优于 8.9 px），每 rig 约 0.12 ms，比 bundle adjustment 快约 10^5 倍。在真实数据 TotalCapture 和 CMU Panoptic 上，其绝对/相对旋转匹配或优于离线 rig-coupled bundle adjustment，且快四到五个数量级。在 Panoptic 环绕 rig 上，相对位姿匹配 VGGT、VGGT-Ω、π^3 等最强纯图像基础模型，同时保持 metric 且焦距精度约高 15 倍。
conclusion: RECALL 证明了以 OEM 标定为锚、学习残差与网络内优化相结合，可在单次前向中实现高精度实时多相机重标定。其无需真实采集训练数据、速度快且精度高，有望替代或补充在线 bundle adjustment，用于可移动多相机系统的持续标定。

title: RF3DGS: Reflection-Free 3D Gaussian Splatting with Self-Priors
abstract: 3D reflection removal is crucial in applications demanding high-fidelity visualization, such as museum exhibitions. In this work, we propose Reflection-Free 3D Gaussian Splatting (RF3DGS), a novel method for superior reflection removal. RF3DGS exclusively leverages a widely-adopted photometric prior for reflection removal: that the minimum pixel intensity across multi-view images corresponding to the same 3D point strongly correlates with reflection-free information. However, generalizing this principle to a 3D Gaussian Splatting within a multi-view context is non-trivial. To address this, RF3DGS first optimizes a vanilla 3DGS model using a geometric prior to estimate a coarse, reflection-free depth map for each view. Leveraging these depth maps and photometric prior, a 3D warping process aggregates reflection-free information from auxiliary views to construct a clean transmission pseudo-label for a given reference view. This pseudo-label provides a robust self-supervised signal for optimization. We further introduce an Adaptive Twin Rendering (ATR) loss to synergistically utilize this pseudo-label while preserving high-frequency details from the original, reflection-degraded images. By adeptly fusing these internal 3D self-priors with the ATR loss, RF3DGS demonstrates state-of-the-art reflection removal performance across both synthetic and real-world scenarios. Furthermore, we establish the first 3D reflection removal benchmark, based on the Unity rendering engine, for rigorous quantitative evaluation.
tldr: 提出RF3DGS，利用多视图光度先验与自适应孪生渲染损失实现无反射3D高斯泼溅，并建立首个3D去反射基准。
motivation: 高保真可视化应用（如博物馆展览）对3D去反射有迫切需求，但将多视图光度先验（同一3D点跨视图最小像素强度与无反射信息强相关）推广到3D高斯泼溅并非易事。
method: RF3DGS先用几何先验优化普通3DGS以估计每视图粗略无反射深度图，再结合深度图与光度先验通过3D warping从辅助视图聚合无反射信息，构建参考视图的干净透射伪标签以提供自监督信号；同时引入Adaptive Twin Rendering（ATR）损失，在利用伪标签的同时保留原始反射退化图像中的高频细节。
result: 在合成与真实场景中均取得state-of-the-art的去反射性能；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 该方法通过融合内部3D自先验与ATR损失实现了高性能3D去反射，并基于Unity渲染引擎建立了首个3D去反射基准，为后续严格定量评估提供支撑。

title: Click3R: Interactive Stereo 3D Reconstruction with Sparse Correspondence Clicks
abstract: Despite impressive progress, existing feed-forward large 3D reconstruction models produce a single, irrevocable prediction. When these models fail, there is no mechanism to correct their mistakes. To address this limitation, we introduce Click3R, a framework for interactive geometric correction of feed-forward models using sparse human correspondence clicks. Given an image pair and a small set of cross-view point correspondences provided by a user, Click3R injects geometric constraints into the 3D reconstruction networks through a lightweight point correspondence adapter, enabling the model to resolve ambiguities in challenging scenarios such as repetitive textures, symmetric structures, large viewpoint changes, or textureless regions. To evaluate interactive reconstruction, we curate a challenging benchmark specifically designed to expose failure modes of existing feed-forward 3D reconstruction methods. Experiments show that Click3R reduces reconstruction error with as few as a single correspondence click, improving performance on both standard and our curated benchmarks. Our results highlight that sparse human interaction provides an effective and practical mechanism for correcting geometric reconstruction errors.
tldr: Click3R通过少量跨视图点对应点击交互式修正前馈立体三维重建的几何错误。
motivation: 现有前馈式大规模三维重建模型通常只输出不可修改的单一预测，失败时缺乏纠错机制，尤其在重复纹理、对称结构、大视角变化和无纹理区域等挑战场景中容易产生几何歧义。
method: Click3R利用用户提供的图像对及少量跨视图点对应，通过轻量级点对应适配器将几何约束注入三维重建网络，实现交互式几何校正；同时构建了专门暴露现有前馈方法失败模式的挑战性基准。
result: 实验表明，仅需一次对应点击即可降低重建误差，并在标准基准和所构建的挑战性基准上均取得性能提升。
conclusion: 稀疏人工交互为修正几何重建错误提供了有效且实用的机制，使前馈三维重建模型具备可交互纠错能力，并凸显了交互式重建评测基准的价值。

title: Plant Orbiter: 3D Plant Reconstruction and Generation with Video Diffusion Orbit Cameras and 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Modern digital phenotyping pipelines require the precise measurement of a range of 3D morphological plant traits. The accurate, high throughput acquisition of these traits helps breeders and researchers accelerate the development of new varieties, techniques and products. Recent advances in 3D technologies have enabled a rapid transition from 2D to 3D pipelines, but high throughput acquisition of digital 3D twins of plants remains a significant challenge due to complex morphology, thin structures and occlusions. In this paper we present Plant Orbiter, a new approach to generating 3D plants that leverages recent advances in video diffusion to produce high quality 3D Gaussian Splats of plants from a single image. We show that our method more accurately recreates plant morphology than other state-of-the-art methods, achieving the highest 3D F-score against all baselines, while being more practical for high throughput pipelines due to easier alignment and reduced cost of camera placement. Combined with a 2D diffusion model, we show that our method also achieves state-of-the-art results in the generation of 3D plant models from a text prompt.
tldr: Plant Orbiter 利用视频扩散生成环绕相机，并从单张图像重建高质量植物3D高斯，实现高精度、高通量植物建模。
motivation: 现代数字表型需要精确、高通量地获取植物三维形态性状，以加速育种和新品种开发。但植物形态复杂、结构纤细且遮挡严重，现有从2D到3D流程仍难以高通量获取数字3D孪生。
method: 提出 Plant Orbiter：以视频扩散模型从单张植物图像生成环绕相机轨迹，再用3D Gaussian Splatting重建植物三维高斯表示；结合2D扩散模型，还可由文本提示生成3D植物模型。该方法避免复杂相机布置与对齐，适合高通量流程。
result: 在对比基线中取得最高3D F-score，更准确还原植物形态；因更易对齐且相机布置成本更低，更适合高通量pipeline。与2D扩散结合后，在文本提示生成3D植物模型任务上达到SOTA。
conclusion: 表明视频扩散与3D Gaussian Splatting结合可从单图高效生成高质量植物3D模型，并支持文本到3D生成，为数字表型高通量获取3D植物孪生提供实用方案。

title: Spaghetti Splatting: Differentiating Curvilinear Dirac Masses via Convolution
abstract: In production systems, 3D geometry is represented by primitives such as points, lines, and triangles, as rendering hardware is optimized to generate images from them very efficiently. Learning such primitives from images by volume rendering is challenging, as they are Dirac masses defined at infinitesimal locations in space. EWA splatting, Poisson reconstruction, and 3D Gaussian Splatting overcome this by convolving Dirac masses with a low-frequency kernel, a recipe that generalizes along two axes: the kernel and the primitive. As points and triangles have already received significant attention, we investigate this recipe for curvilinear primitives, and introduce Spaghetti Splatting. We approximate curves by polylines whose convolution converges to that of the continuous curve, and volume render each segment so that connected segments composite without overcounting at their joints. For fast training and inference, we linearize the camera projection per segment, which also accommodates kernels beyond Gaussians, such as Beta kernels. As a point is a curve of zero length, our representation is a strict superset of 3D Gaussian Splatting. It remains competitive with the state-of-the-art on general scenes, outperforms methods specialized to line-like geometry, natively supports anti-aliasing, and produces long connected strands that are directly amenable to physics simulation.
tldr: 提出 Spaghetti Splatting，以折线卷积和逐段体渲染从图像学习曲线基元，兼容 Beta 核并支持抗锯齿。
motivation: 生产系统常用点、线、三角形等基元表示三维几何，但这些基元是空间中的 Dirac 质量，直接通过体渲染从图像学习很困难；现有 EWA splatting、Poisson 重建和 3D Gaussian Splatting 通过低频核卷积缓解该问题，然而曲线基元仍未得到充分研究。
method: 方法用折线近似曲线，使折线卷积收敛到连续曲线卷积；对每段进行体渲染并保证连接处不重复计数，同时逐段线性化相机投影以加速训练与推理，并可适配 Beta 等非高斯核。由于点是零长度曲线，该表示是 3D Gaussian Splatting 的严格超集。
result: 在通用场景上该方法与当前最优方法保持竞争力，在线状几何上优于专用方法，并原生支持抗锯齿；还能生成可直接用于物理模拟的长连接线束。摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 该工作将 splatting 的“核卷积+基元”思路扩展到曲线基元，提出统一的曲线体渲染框架，增强了线状几何重建、抗锯齿和物理仿真可用性，并可能推动生产级几何基元从图像中学习。

title: V3DSAM: Semantic-Geometric Loop Verification and Geometry-Anchored Persistent Instance Mapping for Feed-Forward Dense SLAM
abstract: To address unreliable cross-view association in long-sequence feed-forward dense SLAM, this letter presents V3DSAM, an open-vocabulary semantic dense SLAM system that establishes physical correspondences at both the scene and object levels. The system combines feed-forward geometric estimates from VGGT-SLAM 2.0 with open-vocabulary semantic observations from SAM3. We introduce semantic-geometric dual-scale loop verification, which identifies false loop closures using pixel-level bidirectional reprojection and object-level 3D spatial correspondences, without accessing backbone-internal features. We further propose geometry-anchored persistent instance mapping, which defines physical instances through class-constrained 3D connectivity in an optimized global coordinate system and assigns global IDs without inter-frame identity propagation. The proposed verifier rejects all four false loop candidates in our TUM RGB-D evaluation, while long-sequence ScanNet experiments show improved instance identity consistency. Thus, V3DSAM reduces dependence on internal backbone features and temporal ID propagation for robust long-term cross-view association.
tldr: V3DSAM结合前馈几何与开放词汇语义，通过双尺度回环验证和几何锚定实例建图提升长期稠密SLAM的跨视图关联可靠性。
motivation: 长序列前馈稠密SLAM中的跨视图关联不可靠，现有方法容易受错误回环闭合和帧间身份传播影响。本文旨在不依赖主干网络内部特征和时间ID传播的情况下，实现稳健的长期场景与物体级物理对应。
method: V3DSAM将VGGT-SLAM 2.0的前馈几何估计与SAM3的开放词汇语义观测相结合。它提出语义-几何双尺度回环验证，利用像素级双向重投影和物体级3D空间对应识别错误回环；并提出几何锚定的持久实例建图，在优化后的全局坐标系中通过类别约束的3D连通性定义物理实例并分配全局ID。
result: 在TUM RGB-D评估中，所提出的验证器拒绝了全部4个错误回环候选；在长序列ScanNet实验中，实例身份一致性得到提升。
conclusion: V3DSAM降低了稳健长期跨视图关联对主干网络内部特征和时序ID传播的依赖，为开放词汇语义稠密SLAM提供了有效的场景级与物体级物理对应方案。

title: Mitigating SM-Level Load Imbalance in 3D Gaussian Splatting on GPUs
abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables photorealistic, real-time rendering on commodity GPUs and is increasingly adopted in generative world models and autonomous driving simulators. However, existing optimizations rely on algorithmic changes that often require retraining, or on specialized accelerators that lack flexibility across evolving 3DGS variants. In this paper, we identify a fundamental inefficiency in GPU-based 3DGS rendering: severe SM-level load imbalance caused by uneven workloads across screen tiles. This imbalance creates a long execution tail, leaving most SMs idle while a few process computationally intensive tiles, particularly in large-scale urban scenes. To address this, we present a software-defined GPU scheduling approach that mitigates the execution tail. Our approach uses a persistent kernel to schedule heavy tiles first and selectively chunks outlier tiles across multiple CTAs. A lightweight per-frame policy determines when and how much to chunk using tile statistics already available in the rendering pipeline. Our approach requires neither retraining nor specialized hardware and can be applied orthogonally to existing optimizations across diverse 3DGS variants. Averaged per scene, it accelerates alpha blending by up to 2.93x on a large-scale urban scene, and by up to 5.6x on its most imbalanced frames, while retaining the original alpha blending formulation.
tldr: 针对3DGS渲染中屏幕瓦片负载不均导致的SM级执行长尾，提出基于持久化内核的软件调度方法，无需重训练即可加速alpha混合。
motivation: 现有3DGS优化多依赖需重训练的算法改动或缺乏灵活性的专用加速器。论文指出GPU渲染中存在严重的SM级负载不均衡：屏幕瓦片工作量不均造成执行长尾，少数SM处理高负载瓦片而多数空闲，在大规模城市场景中尤为突出。
method: 提出软件定义的GPU调度方法，使用持久化内核优先调度重负载瓦片，并选择性地将离群瓦片切分到多个CTA上执行。每帧通过轻量级策略利用渲染管线已有的瓦片统计信息决定何时切分及切分粒度，无需重训练或专用硬件，可与现有3DGS优化正交结合。
result: 按场景平均，在大规模城市场景中将alpha混合加速最高2.93倍；在最不均衡的帧上最高加速5.6倍，同时保留原始alpha混合公式。
conclusion: 该工作将SM级负载不均衡识别为3DGS渲染的关键性能瓶颈，并给出无需重训练、可跨3DGS变体正交部署的软件调度方案，对大规模城市场景实时渲染具有实用价值。

title: EgoLabel: Zero-Shot Egocentric Auto-Labeling with Cross-Modal Consistency
abstract: Egocentric auto-labeling requires depth, camera pose, object, and human-pose estimates to agree across independently developed models. Differences in units, coordinate conventions, and scale can make individually plausible predictions geometrically inconsistent. We present \textbf{EgoLabel}, a zero-shot pipeline that combines off-the-shelf models without target-domain labeled training and provides explicit cross-modal registration and consistency diagnostics. The pipeline integrates MonST3R for geometry, LocateAnything with GMC-BoT-SORT and SAM~2 for objects, and V-HPOT for hands; FisheyeViT provides a separate whole-body compatibility demonstration. Our main hand evaluation uses H2O sensor depth. Across 20 sequences, per-hand depth anchoring reduces the mean of per-sequence median hand--depth residuals by $23\%$ relative to a single global scale, yielding a pooled median of $84.6\,\mathrm{mm}$ against a $20.5\,\mathrm{mm}$ ground-truth reference. Hand PA-MPJPE is $14.53\pm1.29\,\mathrm{mm}$, whereas absolute MPJPE is $119.1\pm31.3\,\mathrm{mm}$, revealing a substantial gap between aligned and metric accuracy. On three RGB-only sequences, camera ATE is $1.40\pm0.29\,\mathrm{cm}$ after $\mathrm{Sim}(3)$ alignment. We also identify a sliding-window implementation issue that allows sensor-initialized depth to change during optimization. Because hand anchoring and its residual share the same depth map, the residual measures internal consistency rather than independent accuracy. These results characterize both the utility and the current limits of the registration pipeline.
tldr: EgoLabel提出零样本第一视角自动标注流水线，通过跨模态配准与一致性诊断整合现成模型。
motivation: 第一视角自动标注需要深度、相机位姿、物体和人体姿态等多个独立模型的结果在几何上一致，但单位、坐标约定和尺度差异会导致单模型看似合理的预测彼此不一致。研究旨在不依赖目标域标注训练的情况下，提供显式跨模态配准与一致性诊断。
method: EgoLabel组合现成模型构建零样本流水线：MonST3R负责几何，LocateAnything结合GMC-BoT-SORT与SAM 2处理物体，V-HPOT处理手部，FisheyeViT用于全身兼容性演示；同时引入跨模态配准、每手深度锚定和一致性残差诊断。
result: 在H2O传感器深度20个序列上，每手深度锚定相较单一全局尺度将每序列手-深度残差中位数的均值降低23%，汇总中位数为84.6 mm，而真值参考为20.5 mm；手部PA-MPJPE为14.53±1.29 mm，绝对MPJPE为119.1±31.3 mm。三个仅RGB序列经Sim(3)对齐后相机ATE为1.40±0.29 cm，并发现滑动窗口实现问题可使传感器初始化深度在优化中改变。
conclusion: 结果表明该配准流水线具有实用价值，但也揭示对齐精度与绝对度量精度之间存在显著差距；由于手部锚定与残差共享同一深度图，残差反映内部一致性而非独立精度，滑动窗口实现问题也限制了当前性能。

title: DPGS-SLAM: Diffusion-Prior and Provenance-Aware Monocular Gaussian Splatting SLAM for Dynamic Visual Sensing
abstract: This paper presents DPGS-SLAM (Diffusion-Prior and Provenance-Aware Monocular Gaussian Splatting SLAM) for dense mapping in environments containing dynamic objects. Dynamic observations can contaminate camera tracking and scene reconstruction in visual SLAM (simultaneous localization and mapping). Although 3DGS (3D Gaussian splatting) enables efficient dense mapping, existing 3DGS-SLAM systems may exhibit instability when dynamic objects violate their underlying static-scene assumption. Excluding dynamic observations can reduce their influence on tracking and mapping, but may leave occluded static backgrounds missing or weakly constrained. Our proposed DPGS-SLAM is a monocular RGB SLAM framework that supports provisional representations of insufficiently observed static backgrounds through asynchronous diffusion-based background completion and provenance-aware Gaussian mapping. Dynamic regions are identified through optical-flow-based motion discovery and temporally consistent mask propagation by SAM2 (segment anything model 2). For selected keyframes, a fine-tuned diffusion inpainting model generates plausible background appearance in occluded regions, while Metric3D v2 predicts metric depth from the completed images to initialize provisional Gaussian primitives. Provenance labels distinguish generated primitives from observation-supported primitives, excluding generated content from camera-pose estimation and observed-map optimization. When previously occluded backgrounds become visible, eligible generated primitives are removed, and observation-supported primitives are independently initialized from real RGB observations and predicted depth. Experimental results demonstrated competitive camera tracking, with average ATE RMSE values of 1.2 cm on TUM RGB-D and 2.7 cm on BONN RGB-D. On StaDy4D, DPGS-SLAM improved average PSNR by 4.60 dB over WildGS-SLAM using only monocular RGB input.
tldr: DPGS-SLAM利用扩散补全与来源感知高斯建图，在动态单目RGB场景中实现鲁棒跟踪与稠密重建。
motivation: 动态物体会污染视觉SLAM的相机跟踪与场景重建，现有3DGS-SLAM在动态场景下违背静态假设而变得不稳定；直接剔除动态观测又会导致被遮挡的静态背景缺失或约束不足。
method: DPGS-SLAM通过光流运动发现与SAM2时序一致掩码传播识别动态区域，对选定关键帧使用微调扩散修复模型补全背景，并由Metric3D v2预测度量深度以初始化临时高斯基元；来源标签区分生成基元与观测支持基元，生成内容不参与相机位姿估计和观测地图优化，待背景可见后移除符合条件的生成基元并用真实RGB观测重新初始化观测支持基元。
result: 实验表明该方法具有竞争力的相机跟踪精度，在TUM RGB-D和BONN RGB-D上的平均ATE RMSE分别为1.2 cm和2.7 cm；在StaDy4D上仅用单目RGB输入，平均PSNR比WildGS-SLAM提升4.60 dB。
conclusion: DPGS-SLAM为观测不足的静态背景提供临时表示，并结合扩散先验与来源感知高斯建图提升动态单目SLAM的跟踪与稠密重建鲁棒性，对动态视觉感知场景具有应用潜力。

title: HIST3R: Decomposing and Rectifying State Updates with History for Streaming 3D Reconstruction
abstract: Streaming 3D reconstruction with recurrent states enables long-video scene understanding under bounded memory, but turns reconstruction into a state-evolution problem: each incoming frame updates a compact scene memory on which all subsequent predictions depend, so unreliable updates overwrite historical context and accumulate into long-horizon geometric drift. We analyze CUT3R-style recurrent updates through a direction--magnitude decomposition, in which the magnitude sets the update gain, i.e., how strongly an observation is written into the state, and the direction encodes the geometric intent, i.e., where the update drives the state. This decomposition provides a unified view of CUT3R and its variants, revealing that existing training-free extensions perform magnitude-only control: they can attenuate an unreliable update but cannot correct its direction. We propose HIST3R, a training-free framework built on CUT3R that controls both components using history. HIST3R rectifies the update direction using locally consistent historical states, and modulates the update magnitude according to the visual discrepancy between the current observation and its history, suppressing redundant updates while preserving complementary evidence. Across camera pose estimation, 3D reconstruction, and video depth estimation, HIST3R consistently improves long-horizon performance while retaining the memory footprint and inference speed of CUT3R. With 1000 input frames, it reduces ATE by 23.87% on ScanNet and 33.65% on TUM-Dynamics relative to the strongest competing method; with 500 frames, it improves median reconstruction accuracy over the strongest CUT3R-based variant by 56.52% on 7-Scenes and 33.96% on NRGBD.
tldr: HIST3R用历史状态校正循环状态更新的方向与幅度，无需训练即可抑制长时序几何漂移。
motivation: 流式三维重建中，每帧都会更新一个紧凑的循环场景记忆，后续所有预测都依赖该记忆；不可靠的更新会覆盖历史上下文，误差随帧数累积形成长时序几何漂移。作者指出，现有CUT3R的无训练扩展只做幅度控制，即仅衰减不可靠更新，而无法纠正其方向，因此漂移问题得不到根本解决。
method: 作者将CUT3R式循环更新分解为方向与幅度两部分：幅度决定更新增益，即观测写入状态的强度；方向编码几何意图，即更新把状态推向何处。基于这一统一视角，提出无需训练的HIST3R框架：利用局部一致的历史状态校正更新的方向；同时根据当前观测与其历史之间的视觉差异调制更新的幅度，从而抑制冗余更新，并保留互补信息。
result: 在相机位姿估计、三维重建和视频深度估计任务上，HIST3R均提升了长时序性能，同时保持与CUT3R相同的内存占用和推理速度。输入1000帧时，ATE在ScanNet上比最强对比方法降低23.87%，在TUM-Dynamics上降低33.65%；输入500帧时，中位重建精度在7-Scenes上比最强CUT3R类变体提升56.52%，在NRGBD上提升33.96%。
conclusion: 该工作表明，方向与幅度分解为理解和改进循环式流式重建提供了统一视角；同时证明仅靠历史信息即可在不增加训练成本、不牺牲效率的前提下同时校正更新方向与幅度，显著缓解长时序漂移，对有限内存下的长视频三维感知具有实用价值。

title: 3R-Adapter: Retrieval, Rewiring, and Refinement for Efficient Adaptation of 3D Reconstruction Model
abstract: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models have demonstrated strong generalization under large-scale pre-training, yet they struggle in long-tail scenarios such as low-light reconstruction, joint human-scene reconstruction, and test-time adaptation. We observe relational attention structure collapse, manifested as the failure of cross-view correspondences, as a primary cause of these limitations. While adaptation offers a practical way to bridge this gap, existing parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) approaches mainly perform channel-wise feature adjustment and lack mechanisms to explicitly adapt relational structures, leaving correspondence failures unresolved. In this work, we formulate adaptation of 3D reconstruction models as a problem of correspondence recovery under domain shift and propose 3R-Adapter, a PEFT paradigm for long-tail 3D reconstruction scenarios. Our method consists of three components: Deformable Retrieval for task-adaptive relation candidate retrieval, Relational Rewiring for reconstructing cross-view relational structures, and Consistency Refinement for injecting the rewired relations into stable predictions. Extensive experiments on low-light reconstruction, joint human-scene reconstruction, and test-time adaptation demonstrate that our approach significantly improves robustness over existing PEFT methods while maintaining efficient lightweight adaptation. Our code is released at https://github.com/PKU-OV3-LAB/3R-Adapter.
tldr: 提出3R-Adapter，通过关系检索、重连与一致性精炼恢复跨视图对应，实现3D重建模型高效长尾自适应。
motivation: 前馈3D重建模型在大规模预训练下泛化较强，但在低光照重建、人体-场景联合重建和测试时自适应等长尾场景中表现不佳。作者观察到关系注意力结构坍塌导致跨视图对应失败，而现有PEFT方法主要做通道级特征调整，缺乏对关系结构的显式适配机制。
method: 将域偏移下的3D重建模型适配建模为对应关系恢复问题，提出PEFT范式3R-Adapter。其包含三部分：Deformable Retrieval进行任务自适应关系候选检索，Relational Rewiring重建跨视图关系结构，Consistency Refinement将重连关系注入稳定预测。
result: 在低光照重建、人体-场景联合重建和测试时自适应实验中，3R-Adapter相比现有PEFT方法显著提升鲁棒性，同时保持轻量高效适配；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 3R-Adapter通过显式恢复跨视图关系结构，为长尾3D重建场景提供高效PEFT方案，缓解关系注意力结构坍塌与对应失败问题，并已开源代码。

title: UltraVoxelGS: Voxel-First Feed-Forward Gaussian Splatting for 3D Ultrasound Reconstruction
abstract: We present UltraVoxelGS, a 3D ultrasound reconstruction method that achieves both fast reconstruction and physically faithful rendering for the first time, bringing live spatial feedback during 2D ultrasound scanning within reach. This is made possible by a feed-forward design that predicts a complete Gaussian scene representation from posed ultrasound images directly, entirely bypassing the per-scene optimization bottleneck that has confined prior methods to offline use. Realising such feed-forward prediction in this setting is non-trivial: unlike natural images, ultrasound slices share at most one-dimensional intersections and exhibit view-dependent appearance due to acoustic propagation and attenuation, violating the dense overlap and photometric consistency assumed by existing feed-forward Gaussian methods. Hence, to achieve fast reconstruction, we introduce a feed-forward voxel-to-Gaussian pass that decouples representation size from input count by lifting all posed slices into a fixed-size voxel support and predicting Gaussian parameters directly. For faithful rendering, we propose ultrasound-aware appearance rendering strategy factorize reflection from cumulative attenuation during training and exploit appearance continuity among spatially adjacent slices for efficient Render-time Appearance Adaptation. On both real-world and simulated datasets, UltraVoxelGS achieves best PSNR/SSIM compared with per-scene optimization baselines while reducing inference from 10-20 minutes to approximately 10 seconds (over 35 times faster) and scales to sequences exceeding 1,000 frames. Code is available at https://github.com/YuebyYue/UltraVoxelGS-camera-ready.
tldr: 提出前馈体素到高斯的3D超声重建，约10秒完成且渲染物理保真。
motivation: 现有3D超声重建依赖逐场景优化，需10-20分钟，只能离线使用。自然图像的前馈高斯方法假设稠密重叠与光度一致性，但超声切片最多一维相交，且因声传播与衰减呈现视角相关外观，无法直接适用。
method: 提出前馈体素到高斯通路，将所有带位姿切片提升到固定尺寸体素支撑并直接预测高斯参数，使表示规模与输入帧数解耦。训练时分解反射与累积衰减实现超声感知外观渲染，并利用空间相邻切片的外观连续性进行渲染时外观自适应。
result: 在真实与仿真数据集上，PSNR/SSIM优于逐场景优化基线；推理时间从10-20分钟降至约10秒（超过35倍加速），并可扩展到超过1000帧的序列。
conclusion: 首次同时实现快速重建与物理保真渲染，有望为2D超声扫描提供实时空间反馈，推动前馈高斯泼溅在医学超声中的应用，代码已开源。

title: Watching Itself Watch: Self-Auditing Visual Reliance for Video Reasoning
abstract: Video reasoning hinges on a small number of visually decisive tokens embedded in otherwise largely language-driven chains of thought. Yet prevailing post-training methods such as GRPO overlook this structure, assigning coarse trajectory-level rewards while requiring multiple rollouts and often costly external judges. We introduce Visually-Aware On-Policy Self-Distillation (VIOS), a post-training framework that identifies where a model under-utilizes visual evidence and concentrates learning at those positions. Our key insight is that a model can audit its own visual reliance: the divergence between its next-token distributions with and without the video reveals how strongly each prediction depends on the visual input. Measuring this reliance for both a student and an answer-privileged teacher exposes a per-token reliance gap, identifying positions where the teacher exploits visual evidence that the student overlooks. VIOS translates this signal into dense, targeted supervision through three complementary components: an exponential moving average (EMA) teacher that co-evolves with the student, a contrastive objective that encourages predictions to depend on the video, and a reliance-gap gate that focuses learning on visually under-utilized tokens. Crucially, VIOS requires only a single on-policy rollout from a single model, without external rewards, judges, or larger teachers. Across 12 benchmarks spanning general, temporal, spatial, knowledge-intensive, and long-video understanding, VIOS consistently improves three model backbones and outperforms contemporary video-reasoning systems, while training in over 9x fewer steps, 60x fewer FLOPs, and 111x fewer generated tokens. Project page: https://vision.cs.utexas.edu/projects/VIOS/
tldr: VIOS通过自审计视觉依赖，在单次on-policy rollout中对视觉欠利用token施加密集监督，高效提升视频推理。
motivation: 现有GRPO等视频推理后训练方法采用粗粒度轨迹级奖励，忽视语言主导思维链中少数视觉决定性token，且依赖多次rollout和昂贵外部评判。VIOS旨在定位模型未充分利用视觉证据的位置，并施加更密集、更有针对性的监督。
method: VIOS让模型比较有视频与无视频时下一token分布的差异，以量化逐token视觉依赖；再比较学生模型与答案特权教师模型的依赖差，得到reliance gap。框架结合与学生共同进化的EMA教师、鼓励预测依赖视频的对比目标，以及聚焦视觉欠利用token的reliance-gap门控，仅需单模型单次on-policy rollout，无需外部奖励、评判器或更大教师。
result: 在覆盖通用、时序、空间、知识密集和长视频理解的12个基准上，VIOS稳定提升三种模型骨干并优于当代视频推理系统；训练步数减少9倍以上、FLOPs减少60倍、生成token减少111倍。
conclusion: VIOS将自审计的逐token视觉依赖转化为密集监督，在无外部奖励和评判器条件下高效提升视频推理能力，并大幅降低训练计算与采样成本，为视频推理后训练提供了可扩展的新范式。

title: Scale-Consistent Monocular Fisheye Visual Odometry via Spherical Bundle Adjustment-Guided Unsupervised Depth Learning
abstract: The wide field of view of fisheye cameras and the simplicity of a monocular setup make monocular fisheye visual odometry (VO) attractive for robotic localization and mapping. Nevertheless, scale drift remains a major challenge over long trajectories. Unsupervised depth learning can help to mitigate this issue, but the pronounced distortion of fisheye images poses challenges for accurate depth estimation. This article presents S$^2$D-FVO, a monocular fisheye VO framework integrating spherical bundle adjustment (SBA)-guided unsupervised depth learning to improve scale consistency and depth estimation accuracy. Given that pixel reprojection residuals do not uniformly reflect angular deviations between viewing rays and that the first-order linearization of a scalar angular reprojection residual is insensitive to perturbations along one tangent direction, SBA employs tangent-space angular reprojection residuals derived from the spherical logarithmic map. These residuals retain sensitivity along both tangent directions, with their norms equal to the corresponding scalar angular residuals. A median depth-based scale regularization term is further integrated into SBA to constrain the reconstruction scale. Building on these formulations, SBA replaces the pose estimation network during unsupervised depth learning, providing more reliable relative poses for view synthesis. In turn, depth estimates from the well-trained depth estimation network provide scale references for SBA, improving scale consistency while allowing individual 3-D landmark positions to be refined. Extensive experiments conducted on multiple public datasets, as well as two newly collected large-scale datasets, demonstrate that the proposed framework outperforms representative existing approaches in both depth and trajectory estimation accuracy and is applicable to different camera models.
tldr: 提出S²D-FVO，用球面光束法平差引导无监督深度学习，提升鱼眼单目视觉里程计的尺度一致性与深度精度。
motivation: 鱼眼相机视野宽且单目配置简单，使单目鱼眼视觉里程计适合机器人定位与建图，但长轨迹上尺度漂移仍是主要挑战。无监督深度学习可缓解该问题，然而鱼眼图像显著畸变会影响深度估计准确性。
method: 提出S²D-FVO框架，将球面光束法平差（SBA）与无监督深度学习结合：SBA采用基于球面对数映射的切空间角度重投影残差，使其在两个切方向上均保持敏感性，并加入基于中值深度的尺度正则项约束重建尺度。SBA在无监督深度学习中替代位姿估计网络，为视图合成提供更可靠相对位姿；训练好的深度网络反过来为SBA提供尺度参考，提升尺度一致性并细化三维路标位置。
result: 在多个公开数据集以及两个新采集的大规模数据集上，该框架在深度估计和轨迹估计精度上均优于代表性现有方法，并适用于不同相机模型；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 该工作表明，将球面光束法平差与无监督深度学习结合可有效改善单目鱼眼视觉里程计的尺度一致性和深度估计精度，并具备跨相机模型的适用性，对机器人定位与建图具有潜在价值。

title: ACROSSVAM3.0: Resource-Bounded 4D Scene Construction and Adaptive Surface Association
abstract: Combining video generation, dynamic reconstruction and monocular SLAM requires consistent coordinates, explicit handling of missing outputs and predictable memory use. We present AcrossVAM3.0, an offline system that converts text, images or monocular RGB video into a versioned point representation. Frozen components run sequentially on one GPU; map corrections update cameras, points and trajectories together. The coordination layer adds no neural parameters. Three fresh input-mode runs completed with a maximum sampled task-process-tree GPU footprint of 17.14 GB. In a frozen 16-scene video suite, every scene yielded a 4D reconstruction and 15 yielded a non-empty SLAM map. Strict cross-window matching reduced local surface error but lost long-range track coverage on TAP-Vid-DAVIS. We therefore developed multi-hypothesis adaptive surface chaining (MHAC), which retains several candidate matches and an explicit missing state. After selection on disjoint development data, MHAC improved Average Jaccard over a position-only baseline by 0.1394 on a frozen ten-video holdout (95% bootstrap interval [0.1074,0.1689]). Across 265 RoboTAP videos, the mean paired gain was 0.0610 ([0.0510,0.0715]), with 215 wins, one tie and 49 losses. These results support resource-bounded scene construction and an external tracking gain under the tested protocol. They do not establish metric scale, semantic identity or high-fidelity novel-view rendering.
tldr: AcrossVAM3.0 在单 GPU 资源约束下将文本、图像或单目视频转为版本化点表示，并联合校正相机、点与轨迹。
motivation: 研究旨在统一视频生成、动态重建与单目 SLAM，解决多组件组合时坐标不一致、输出缺失需显式处理以及内存开销不可预测的问题。
method: 系统离线运行冻结组件于单 GPU，协调层不含神经参数，将文本、图像或单目 RGB 视频转换为版本化点表示，并在建图修正时同步更新相机、点和轨迹。针对跨窗口匹配覆盖不足，提出多假设自适应表面链接 MHAC，保留多个候选匹配及显式缺失状态。
result: 三次新输入模式运行的最大采样任务进程树 GPU 占用为 17.14 GB；16 场景视频套件均完成 4D 重建，15 个得到非空 SLAM 地图。冻结十视频留出集上 MHAC 较仅位置基线将 Average Jaccard 提升 0.1394（95% bootstrap 区间 [0.1074,0.1689]），RoboTAP 265 视频平均配对增益 0.0610（[0.0510,0.0715]），215 胜 1 平 49 负。
conclusion: 结果表明在测试协议下可实现资源受限的场景构建并获得外部跟踪增益，但未建立度量尺度、语义身份或高保真新视角渲染能力。

title: Budget-aware Correspondence-driven View Selection for Real-time 3D Perception of Mobile Robots
abstract: 3D visual perception and scene reconstruction are critical for autonomous robots and intelligent transportation, yet real-world deployments often generate long, redundant image sequences that hinder downstream processing. This report investigates BCVS (budget-aware correspondence-driven view sampling), a pose-free view selection algorithm that offers 22+ FPS on a CPU, enabling online filtering for efficient 3D perception by mobile robots. Unlike existing approaches that rely on full structure-from-motion (SfM) pipelines or camera pose estimation, BCVS employs a purely correspondence-based scoring strategy that prioritizes view novelty while maintaining sufficient overlap for geometric stability. Given a user-specified budget, BCVS iteratively selects the most distinct frames and suppresses near-duplicates, producing compact subsets that preserve connectivity and minimize reconstruction loss. Extensive experiments on benchmark show that BCVS outperforms CPU-friendly baselines at tight budgets and remains competitive as budgets scale. Field trials with large aerial and marine robotics data further validate its practicality and scalability: BCVS reduces redundancy up to 16% while sustaining robust SfM registration and high-quality 3D reconstructions.
tldr: BCVS是一种无需位姿的预算感知视图选择算法，可在CPU上以22+ FPS在线过滤冗余图像并保持三维重建质量。
motivation: 真实机器人部署常产生长且冗余的图像序列，严重阻碍下游三维感知与重建处理；现有方法多依赖完整SfM流程或相机位姿估计，计算成本高，难以满足移动机器人实时在线过滤需求。
method: BCVS采用纯对应关系驱动的评分策略，无需相机位姿或完整SfM，在用户给定预算下迭代选择最具新颖性的帧并抑制近重复帧，同时保持足够重叠以维持几何连通性和重建稳定性。
result: 在基准实验中，BCVS在紧预算下优于CPU友好基线，并随预算扩大保持竞争力；在大型航空与海洋机器人现场数据中，冗余最高降低16%，同时维持稳健的SfM配准和高质量三维重建，并在CPU上达到22+ FPS。
conclusion: BCVS提供了一种实用、可扩展的在线视图选择方案，其无需位姿、预算感知和对应关系驱动的特点有助于移动机器人高效三维感知与重建，并具备在真实大规模场景中部署的潜力。

title: Towards Rotation-Only Imaging Geometry: Multi-View Pose Estimation
abstract: Global structure-from-motion (SfM) commonly refines relative poses on individual image pairs and then estimates global rotations by rotation averaging. Pairwise refinement does not explicitly combine feature-level constraints with multi-view consistency during rotation initialization. We introduce Global Rotations from Aggregated Matches (GRAM), which estimates global rotations directly from initial relative rotations and inlier matches by minimizing edge-wise rotation-only algebraic residuals. GRAM replaces two-view relative-pose optimization and rotation averaging with a single stage. We further extend rotation- only imaging geometry to multiple views and develop Multi-view Optimization with Rotation-only Reprojection Error (MORE) for nonlinear global rotation refinement. Analytical Rotation-guided Translation (ART) derives locally scaled triplet translations from Linear Global Translation (LiGT) constraints and recovers global translations using weighted least squares. Synthetic and real-world experiments demonstrate the accuracy, robustness, and efficiency of the proposed methods.
tldr: 提出GRAM、MORE和ART，以单阶段全局旋转估计替代两视图优化与旋转平均，并扩展到多视图旋转几何和平移恢复。
motivation: 全局SfM通常先对图像对做相对位姿细化，再做旋转平均，未能在旋转初始化阶段显式结合特征级约束与多视图一致性。本文旨在直接用初始相对旋转和内点匹配估计全局旋转，并统一多视图旋转几何与平移恢复。
method: GRAM通过最小化边级旋转-only代数残差，从初始相对旋转和内点匹配直接估计全局旋转，将两视图相对位姿优化与旋转平均合并为单阶段。MORE将旋转-only成像几何扩展到多视图，利用旋转-only重投影误差进行非线性全局旋转精化；ART基于LiGT约束从三元组推导局部尺度平移，并用加权最小二乘恢复全局平移。
result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标；合成与真实世界实验表明，所提方法在精度、鲁棒性和效率方面具有优势。
conclusion: 本文将全局旋转初始化与非线性精化统一到旋转-only几何框架，并将旋转引导用于平移恢复，为全局SfM提供了更紧凑的位姿估计流程；实验验证了其精度、鲁棒性与效率。

title: RetinexGS: Retinex-Inspired Gaussian Splatting for Low-Light RAW Reconstruction
abstract: Standard 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) pipelines struggle with severely underexposed images, producing unstable colors, floating artifacts, and incomplete reconstructions in dark regions. To better account for noise in these low-light observations, RAW images offer a natural basis for noise-aware reconstruction by preserving linear sensor measurements and providing access to noise metadata. We present RetinexGS, a RAW-domain 3DGS framework that combines Retinex-inspired appearance modeling with sensor-informed optimization for low-light novel-view synthesis. We factorize each Gaussian's color into a view-independent base color and a shared, position- and view-dependent modulation field, regularizing the two components separately to constrain appearance learning from noisy observations. We use DNG noise metadata to weight the reconstruction loss for signal-dependent noise, while distortion-aware rendering avoids spatially resampling RAW targets. To address sparse geometry in dark regions, we introduce depth-guided initialization. We evaluate RetinexGS on three public RawNeRF scenes and two custom-captured low-light RAW scenes. With all methods trained on the same RAW inputs for each scene, RetinexGS outperforms LE3D and RawNeRF in mean sRGB PSNR by 2.18 dB and 2.71 dB respectively, across the five scenes, while supporting real-time novel-view rendering.
tldr: RetinexGS 在 RAW 域结合 Retinex 分解与噪声感知优化，实现低光照新视角实时重建。
motivation: 标准 3DGS 在严重欠曝图像上会出现颜色不稳定、漂浮伪影和暗区重建不完整的问题；RAW 图像保留线性传感器测量与噪声元数据，更适合噪声感知的低光照重建。
method: 提出 RAW 域 3DGS 框架 RetinexGS，将每个高斯颜色分解为视角无关的基础色和共享的位置/视角相关调制场，并分别正则化以约束含噪外观学习。利用 DNG 噪声元数据对信号相关噪声加权重建损失，采用畸变感知渲染避免对 RAW 目标进行空间重采样，并引入深度引导初始化以缓解暗区稀疏几何问题。
result: 在 3 个公开 RawNeRF 场景和 2 个自采集低光照 RAW 场景上，所有方法均使用相同 RAW 输入训练，RetinexGS 在五场景平均 sRGB PSNR 上分别比 LE3D 和 RawNeRF 高 2.18 dB 和 2.71 dB，并支持实时新视角渲染。
conclusion: RetinexGS 为低光照 RAW 新视角合成提供了噪声感知的 RAW 域 3DGS 方案，可改善暗区重建稳定性与渲染质量，并保持实时性，对低光照三维重建具有潜在应用价值。

title: Feel My Focus: Gaze-Triggered Digital Twin Creation for Remote Collaboration
abstract: We present Feel My Focus, a gaze-triggered mixed reality (MR) demonstration that enables rapid creation and sharing of lightweight 3D digital twins during remote collaboration. Unlike systems that use gaze primarily as a referential pointer, Feel My Focus treats sustained visual attention as a generative action: a fixation on a physical object initiates single-image capture, attention-guided segmentation, and one-shot 3D reconstruction, allowing a remote partner to inspect and discuss the object in situ. The system integrates gaze-tracking glasses, modular segmentation and reconstruction services, and an MR client for runtime streaming and interaction. This design prioritizes responsiveness and experiential continuity over photometric fidelity. We report observations from a public demonstration, highlighting design trade-offs, failure modes, and user control considerations for deploying gaze-triggered generative systems in real-world collaborative settings.
tldr: 系统以持续注视触发单图分割与单样本三维重建，快速生成可共享的轻量数字孪生以支持远程协作。
motivation: 远程协作需要快速创建并共享物理对象的轻量3D表示；现有系统多将凝视作为指向工具，而该工作把持续视觉注意视为生成动作，并优先保证响应性与体验连续性而非光度保真。
method: 集成凝视追踪眼镜、模块化分割与重建服务以及MR客户端进行运行时流式传输和交互；当用户注视物理对象时，触发单图像捕获、注意力引导分割和one-shot 3D重建，使远程伙伴能够原位查看并讨论该对象。
result: 摘要报告了公开演示中的观察，重点讨论设计权衡、失败模式和用户控制考虑，未提供量化实验结果或性能指标。
conclusion: 该工作展示了凝视触发式生成数字孪生在真实远程协作场景中的可行性，贡献在于将持续注视转化为生成式交互范式，并总结了部署此类MR协作系统的经验与潜在影响。

title: Martine: Benchmarking Multi-View 3D Surface Reconstruction Across Viewpoint Coverage, Resolution, and Lighting
abstract: Controlled acquisition setups are widely used for high-accuracy multi-view 3D surface reconstruction, as they allow sensor configuration, image resolution, viewpoint distribution, and illumination to be specified. Yet benchmarking remains difficult, since reconstruction accuracy depends jointly on the reconstruction paradigm, object properties, and acquisition regime. Existing benchmarks often restrict viewpoint coverage, resolution, or illumination, which can bias comparisons towards methods suited to the chosen setting. Others lack accurate 3D ground truth or quantified image-to-geometry alignment, limiting their use for metric surface evaluation. We introduce Martine, a benchmark for controlled 3D object surface reconstruction. Martine comprises 28 objects, including transparent materials and fine structures, captured at 9568 x 6376 pixels from 84 views over a spherical cap under both single-light and multi-light regimes. It provides object-independent camera calibration, accurate 3D ground-truth scans, calibration and image-to-geometry accuracy quantified on test images, and 3D property masks for analysing errors by material properties, visibility, curvature and fine structures. Experiments across photogrammetry, classical multi-view stereo, neural implicit surfaces, Gaussian-splatting-based reconstruction, and multi-view photometric stereo show that Martine enables regime-aware evaluation with explicit control over reference-data accuracy. The benchmark resolves sub-millimetric reconstruction differences, with a best observed Chamfer distance of 0.058 mm over the evaluated visible surface.
tldr: Martine 是受控多视角三维表面重建基准，覆盖视角、分辨率与光照变化。
motivation: 现有基准常限制视角覆盖、分辨率或光照，导致比较偏向特定采集条件的方法；部分基准缺乏精确三维真值或量化的图像到几何对齐，难以进行度量表面评估。Martine 旨在提供可控采集条件下的公平、工况感知重建评测。
method: 构建包含28个物体（含透明材质与精细结构）的数据集，在球冠上以84视角、9568×6376分辨率、单光源和多光源条件采集；提供物体无关相机标定、精确三维真值扫描、测试图像上的标定与图像到几何精度量化，以及按材质属性、可见性、曲率和精细结构分析误差的三维属性掩码。评测覆盖摄影测量、经典多视图立体、神经隐式表面、基于Gaussian-splatting的重建和多视图光度立体。
result: 在可见表面上最佳Chamfer距离为0.058 mm，并可分辨亚毫米级重建差异；跨多种范式实验表明该基准支持对参考数据精度进行显式控制的工况感知评测。
conclusion: Martine 提供了高分辨率、多光照、带精确真值和属性掩码的受控多视角表面重建基准，支持按采集工况与物体属性进行公平比较和误差分析。其贡献在于提升基准的可控性与度量可靠性，并可能推动透明物体、精细结构等困难场景的重建研究。

title: FastGRT: Accelerating Training of 3D Gaussian Ray Tracing
abstract: Ray Tracing enables rendering capabilities that are difficult to achieve with rasterization-based approaches such as 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS). However, the training cost of Gaussian-based ray tracing (GRT) is much higher than that of 3DGS. In this paper, we study how ray tracing using Gaussians executes on GPUs and show that a considerable fraction of the training cost arises from how the computation is organized. We develop FastGRT, which decouples ray traversal from blending and reuses work done in the forward pass for the backward pass. FastGRT further incorporates optimizations such as fast gradient accumulation and a hybrid BVH update strategy to tackle other major bottlenecks in the training pipeline. We implement FastGRT in Vulkan. To the best of our knowledge, it is the first Vulkan-based GRT implementation that supports both training and rendering.
